result.title: SWXAI: A Unified Multimodal Explainability Library for Space Weather Forecasting and Heliophysics
result.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at CIKM 2026 (Resource Track), Rome, Italy, November 7-11, 2026. Code: https://bitbucket.org/gsudmlab/swxai Docs: https://swxai.readthedocs.io
result.summary: Space weather forecasting and heliophysics increasingly rely on machine learning models that process heterogeneous inputs such as multi-viewpoint multi-wavelength solar images and rasters, multivariate time series, spatial annotations, and tabular event-level data. However, explainability workflows remain fragmented across libraries, model interfaces, and output formats, limiting reuse and reproducibility. We present SWXAI, an open-source library that unifies explainable AI (XAI) workflows for image, time-series, and tabular data in space weather forecasting and heliophysics. SWXAI provides a common, extensible interface across commonly used vision, time-series, and tabular learning models, with validation, adaptation, and persistent explanation objects. It also includes domain-grounded examples, reproducible notebooks, tests, and documentation, enabling users to inspect outputs, swap models or explainers, and extend workflows to new heliophysics datasets. SWXAI reduces modality-specific engineering overhead and supports comparable, reusable explanations across heterogeneous scientific machine learning pipelines. A benchmark against direct backend implementations shows that SWXAI substantially reduces the code users write to produce an explanation, with no practical runtime cost.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出开源库 SWXAI，为空间天气与太阳物理预测中的图像、时间序列和表格模型提供统一的 XAI 接口、持久化解释对象、可复现示例与文档，并与直接调用后端实现对比，说明可减少用户代码量且无明显运行开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨模态统一解释器接口与可持久化解释对象，可能为 LVR 中「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」的贡献归因与诊断流程提供可核查的工具线索，但该库面向领域预测而非 latent 推理状态，迁移需较多改造。
